collection.name: Chapter 14
collection.notes: I would like a cup of hot coffee
collection.objectives: Order beverages at a coffee shop; list the common beverages and foods at a coffee shop; express liking for beverages and foods

words.english: measure word for slice of cake

sentences.traditional: 小姐，我要一杯咖啡，加牛奶，不加糖。
sentences.simplified: 小姐，我要一杯咖啡，加牛奶，不加糖。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎojiě, wǒ yào yì bēi kāfēi, jiā niúnǎi, bù jiā táng.
sentences.english: Miss, I would like a cup of coffee, with milk and no sugar.

sentences.pinyin: Nín yào bīng de háishì rè de?
sentences.english: Would you like it iced or hot?

sentences.traditional: 您要大杯、中杯還是小杯的？
sentences.simplified: 您要大杯、中杯还是小杯的？
sentences.pinyin: Nín yào dà bēi, zhōng bēi háishì xiǎo bēi de?
sentences.english: Would you like a large, a medium or a small one?

sentences.traditional: 我要一杯小杯的冰紅茶。
sentences.simplified: 我要一杯小杯的冰红茶。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yào yì bēi xiǎo bēi de bīng hóngchá.
sentences.english: I would like a small iced black tea.

sentences.traditional: 蛋糕太甜了，我想吃鹹的東西。
sentences.simplified: 蛋糕太甜了，我想吃咸的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Dàngāo tài tián le, wǒ xiǎng chī xián de dōngxi.
sentences.english: Cake is too sweet; I want to eat something salty.

sentences.traditional: 如果您點雞肉三明治，我們就送您一杯飲料。
sentences.simplified: 如果您点鸡肉三明治，我们就送您一杯饮料。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nín diǎn jīròusānmíngzhì, wǒmen jiù sòng nín yì bēi yǐnliào.
sentences.english: If you order a chicken sandwich, we will give you a free drink.

sentences.traditional: 明文如果要請我吃晚飯，我就一定去。
sentences.simplified: 明文如果要请我吃晚饭，我就一定去。
sentences.pinyin: Míngwén rúguǒ yào qǐng wǒ chī wǎnfàn, wǒ jiù yídìng qù.
sentences.english: If Mingwen wants to treat me to dinner, I will definitely go.

sentences.traditional: 家文跟林小姐一樣，都要一個雞肉三明治。
sentences.simplified: 家文跟林小姐一样，都要一个鸡肉三明治。
sentences.pinyin: Jiāwén gēn Lín xiǎojiě yíyàng, dōu yào yí ge jīròusānmíngzhì.
sentences.english: Jiawen is the same as Miss Lin; they both want a chicken sandwich.

sentences.pinyin: Tā de bèibāo gēn wǒ de yíyàng.
sentences.english: His backpack is the same as mine.
Mandarin is just as hard as French.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen hái yào liǎng bēi bīngshuǐ.
sentences.english: We would also like two glasses of iced water.
Please wait a moment; it will be right out.

sentences.traditional: 那家咖啡店的蛋糕做得很好。
sentences.simplified: 那家咖啡店的蛋糕做得很好。
sentences.pinyin: Nà jiā kāfēidiàn de dàngāo zuò de hěn hǎo.
sentences.english: That coffee shop makes very good cake.

sentences.traditional: 因為家文和林小姐都愛吃甜的東西，所以一起點一塊大蛋糕。
sentences.simplified: 因为家文和林小姐都爱吃甜的东西，所以一起点一块大蛋糕。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi Jiāwén hé Lín xiǎojiě dōu ài chī tián de dōngxi, suǒyǐ yìqǐ diǎn yí kuài dà dàngāo.
sentences.english: Because Jiawen and Miss Lin both love sweet things, they ordered a large slice of cake together.

sentences.traditional: 林小姐只點一個三明治和一杯水。
sentences.simplified: 林小姐只点一个三明治和一杯水。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě zhǐ diǎn yí ge sānmíngzhì hé yì bēi shuǐ.
sentences.english: Miss Lin only ordered a sandwich and a glass of water.

sentences.traditional: 妳想吃甜的包子還是鹹的？
sentences.simplified: 你想吃甜的包子还是咸的？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng chī tián de bāozi háishì xián de?
sentences.english: Do you want a sweet steamed bun or a savory one?

sentences.traditional: 我喜歡吃雞肉，不喜歡吃魚。
sentences.simplified: 我喜欢吃鸡肉，不喜欢吃鱼。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān chī jīròu, bù xǐhuān chī yú.
sentences.english: I like to eat chicken, but I don't like to eat fish.
